# ScaffoldShell fixtures

Reference exports from the Processing version, one folder per case: `fold.svg` (cut file),
`print.pdf` (print file), `frame.scad` (the scaffold, exactly as Processing wrote it) and
`params.json` (the inputs and the PaperPrototyping commit). Generated by
`node scripts/fixtures/scaffoldshell/generate.mjs` from `scripts/fixtures/scaffoldshell/cases.json`,
exporting as the E key does. Do not edit by hand.
